parts.text: 100 x 50 cubits, linen hangings 5 cubits high
parts.mapping: the outer baffle and listening space

calc.note: the base of the whole harmonic frame: every dimension that divides 100 cubits is a harmonic of 3.85 Hz

parts.ref: Exod 26 (20 x 10 x 10 cubits, inferred from the boards)
parts.text: 48 acacia boards 10 x 1.5 cubits, gold-overlaid, on 96 silver sockets
parts.mapping: the tuning chamber: the outer resonator
the feet: isolation of the resonator from the ground (like a bridge's feet)

parts.text: 4 layers: twined linen (10 curtains 28 x 4), goat hair (11 curtains 30 x 4), rams' skins, tachash skins
parts.mapping: the skin: damping and sealing layers that set how long the chamber rings

parts.text: woven linen, blue, purple, scarlet, cherubim; 10 x 10 cubits
parts.mapping: the diaphragm between the two chambers: couples and filters them

calc.note: one note on all three axes; modes stack (round 38)

parts.text: acacia box 2.5 x 1.5 x 1.5 cubits, gold inside and out

calc.note: 2.5 cubits is 1/4 of the tabernacle's 10 and 1/8 of Solomon's 20: the ark's tone is 2 and 3 octaves above its room

parts.text: gold slab 2.5 x 1.5; two cherubim of beaten gold, wings spread over it, faces toward each other; 'from between the two cherubim I will speak with you'
parts.mapping: the mouth: two wings forming a horn over the soundbox, the point the voice comes from

parts.text: beaten gold, one shaft, six branches (3 each side), seven lamps; cups, knobs, flowers
parts.mapping: the seven voices: a heptachord with the central shaft as the mese (Philo: the middle lamp is the Sun)

calc.note: mese tuned to the ark's note, 154.2 Hz

parts.text: acacia 2 x 1 x 1.5 cubits, gold; 12 loaves
parts.mapping: the tuning standard (monochord): octave 2:1, fifth 3:2, fourth 4:3 in one object; 12 loaves = 12 notes (Josephus' 12-note nabla)

parts.text: acacia 1 x 1 x 2 cubits, gold; incense morning and evening
parts.mapping: the breath: the air supply (smoke = moving air)

parts.text: acacia 5 x 5 x 3 cubits, bronze-overlaid, 'hollow with boards', a bronze grating halfway down
parts.mapping: the drum: a large hollow bronze body

calc.singing_tube_check: a heated hollow with a grating is a Rijke tube, but a grating at mid-height sits where the fundamental is not driven: it would not sing (N)

parts.text: Solomon's sea: 10 cubits across, 5 high, a handbreadth thick, on 12 bronze oxen

calc.note: bell scaling f ~ t/D^2 from a 1 m, 7 cm bell at 440 Hz: an order-of-magnitude estimate only

parts.text: bronze, 18 cubits high, 12 in circumference, hollow, four fingers thick; capitals with lily-work and 200 pomegranates
parts.mapping: the bass: two hollow bronze tubes flanking the entrance

parts.text: two, beaten silver; 'a little less than a cubit long, a narrow tube a little thicker than an aulos, ending in a bell'
blue robe; golden bells and pomegranates alternating on the hem (72 bells, 72 clappers); 'its sound shall be heard when he goes into the holy place'
parts.mapping: the shaker: percussion sounded by the player's own movement

parts.text: 12 stones in 4 rows of 3, names of the 12 tribes; Urim and Thummim inside
parts.mapping: the display: 12 outputs, one for each of the 12 notes

frame.note: Every length that divides 100 cubits (100, 50, 20, 10, 5, 2.5, 2, 1) is a harmonic of the court's 3.85 Hz: the ark is harmonic 40, the Holy of Holies 10, the Holy Place 5. Lengths of 1.5, 3, 28 and 30 cubits are not.

sequence: 25 s the menorah's seven voices, Moon to Saturn
34 s the voice from between the cherubim: 'ehyeh asher ehyeh' (vowel line) on the ark note
throughout: the building's harmonic series (harmonics 20-80 of 3.85 Hz)
